strongest_objection: The originally varied holding reaches P2, which also directly pays A at receiver launch. The collateral effect of that change could account for a changed grant without requiring the donor descendant.
response: Match the complete valued launch banks. Recompute every mixed and pure obligation through the later G, including grants and actual payments. Trace D2 to a mixed co-parent, test the other input to P2, and require continuing pure chains from the specific G and D2. Report only a combined founder effect if any independent route suffices.
advisor_verdict: The revision resolves the main causal objection. It requires the study to trace every changed obligation through G’s own grant and completed payments, and to report a combined founder effect if P2’s changed earlier input can independently explain the count. It also fixes the physical release match before scoring and requires continuing, funded parent-to-child chains starting at G and D2. No further design revision is required.
